page_title: ETI 1-1 NAN | St Etienne v Nantes 19/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' Sorba Thomas (Nantes) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
90+4' The resulting corner from Sorba Thomas (Nantes) is cleared by the opposition's defence. The ball goes out of play. Nantes are awarded a corner kick.

90+3' Mickael Nade (St Etienne) times his run well to meet a lofted cross near the penalty spot, but mistimes his header and sends the ball high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nantes.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Substitution. Benjamin Bouchouari will be replaced by Igor Miladinovic (St Etienne).
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Leo Petrot departs the field of play to be replaced by Pierre Cornud (St Etienne).
87' Antoine Kombouare is forced to make a change. Plamedi Nsingi is unable to continue due to injury, Jean-Philippe Gbamin (Nantes) comes on.

86' 1 - 1 What a goal! Augustine Boakye (St Etienne) receives an accurate pass and tries his luck with a long-range shot. He unleashes a superb strike that goes inside the left post and behind the goalkeeper.
85' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from St Etienne comes to nothing.
85' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
81' Some great play by Augustine Boakye (St Etienne) ends with a shot on the edge of the box low towards the middle of the net, but Anthony Lopes sees it all the way and makes a comfortable save.

80' It looks like Dennis Appiah (St Etienne) saw red with that tackle. Florent Batta won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Free kick. Nantes will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.

77' What an opportunity that was! The ball rebounded out to Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne), whose shot from the edge of the box goes a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.

76' Matthis Abline (Nantes) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom left corner is blocked by Gautier Larsonneur, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
76' Neat passing move from St Etienne in order to create new attacking opportunities.
71' Eirik Horneland decides to make a substitution. Lamine Fomba will be replaced by Mathis Amougou (St Etienne).
71' Antoine Kombouare has decided to substitute Moses Simon and he is replaced by Sorba Thomas (Nantes).
71' Today's match ends for Bahereba Guirassy who will be replaced by Plamedi Nsingi (Nantes).
69' A rebound falls kindly for Augustine Boakye (St Etienne), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nantes.
68' St Etienne quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
68' The resulting corner from Leo Petrot (St Etienne) comes to nothing.
66' St Etienne seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
64' Moses Simon (Nantes) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
63' The game is interrupted now, Moses Simon (Nantes) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
60' Eirik Horneland prepares a substitution. Djyilian N'Guessan is replaced by Augustine Boakye (St Etienne).
60' Substitution. Florian Tardieu (St Etienne) in, Louis Mouton out.
60' Moses Simon (Nantes) whips in a cross from the corner, but Gautier Larsonneur is well positioned and punches the ball away.
59' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Moses Simon (Nantes). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
57' Lucas Stassin (St Etienne) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
55' Moses Simon (Nantes) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
54' Moses Simon (Nantes) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away. The referee signals a corner kick to Nantes.
51' A dangerous looking corner kick from Moses Simon (Nantes) is cleared to safety by the defence.

51' Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. Nantes earn a corner.
50' The St Etienne players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' Florent Batta blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' St Etienne take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' The resulting set piece from St Etienne is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
44' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Douglas Augusto (Nantes) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Louis Leroux.
41' Dylan Batubinsika (St Etienne) picks up a yellow card.
41' A free kick is awarded to Nantes. Florent Batta has a clear sight and sees a foul from Dylan Batubinsika (St Etienne).
39' Caution goes to Pedro Chirivella (Nantes).
36' St Etienne can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
36' St Etienne have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
34' Douglas Augusto (Nantes) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
34' The total number of attempts is 1:2.
32' Great teamplay by St Etienne as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
30' The foul by Lamine Fomba (St Etienne) was seen by Florent Batta who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
29' Lamine Fomba (St Etienne) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Nantes will take a free kick near the side line.
25' St Etienne enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
22' Yellow card! It's like Gautier Larsonneur (St Etienne) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Florent Batta agrees and books him.
19' Matthis Abline (Nantes) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
16' Johann Lepenant (Nantes) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

14' 0 - 1 Moses Simon (Nantes) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Gautier Larsonneur is just a bystander as the ball flies into the top left corner. The score is 0:1.
12' Djyilian N'Guessan (St Etienne) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
11' The percentage of ball possession is – 75:25.
7' Lovely run from Douglas Augusto (Nantes). He finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper, lines up a shot, but the keeper boldly launches himself to intercept the ball.
5' A pass by Moses Simon (Nantes) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
3' St Etienne are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
